selected_work: VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_SET_04:F13 R124 bounded live adoption of the shared producer map for the three exact DispGearPosition/REV HUD callsites 0xB9096, 0xB90B3 and 0xB90F6.
summary: R124 preserves the existing left-side sprite-spacing correction at all three DispGearPosition/REV mid-hook sites while replacing the remaining generic spacing-only callback with exact caller-RVA templates. Each template derives immediate next-draw ScreenHud ownership from GameSemantic::ClassifyCriticalProducer(CallerRva) and compile-time requires the canonical shared producer map. The three RVAs are already classified consistently as DispGearPosition/SCREEN_HUD by disasm_render_contract.hpp, analyze_outrun_exe.py and hud_semantics.hpp. No producer range was widened.

risk_review.reason: src/hooks_uiscaling.cpp and render_semantics.hpp are protected runtime-risk paths. This change does not widen SCREEN_HUD ownership, change D3D state heuristics, or activate native draw routing; it converts only three already-canonical HUD callsites. Prior R51 runtime evidence still shows producer ownership can arrive too late for the c64/WVP boundary, so hosted CI cannot establish visual correctness.
